title: Emerging role of nuclear phospholipase C-β1 in lung cancer.
snippet: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is a highly aggressive malignancy accounting for approximately 85% of all lung cancer cases. To better understand its pathology and prognosis, this study focused on the molecular profiling of tissues and clinical outcomes derived directly from lung cancer patients.
